name: FileResource
description:
FileResource names a File the conversation holds and where the agent
 finds it.

fields.name: FileId
fields.description:
The File's id: "file_01j…". A File of the conversation's organization
 that is not yet the conversation's becomes the conversation's own copy
 when it is named, and the entry names the copy.

fields.name: MountPath
fields.description:
Where the agent finds the File, relative to .stigmer/uploads/: "q3/ledger.xlsx".
 Empty takes the File's filename, made unique among the conversation's
 Files. No leading `/`, no `..` segment, at most 1024 characters.
